citation: Rust BM, et al. Dietary Fat Chain Length, Saturation, and PUFA Source Acutely Affect Diet-Induced Thermogenesis but Not Satiety in Adults. Nutrients 2021.
protocol: Overnight fast in a metabolic unit; five liquid meals (456-517 kcal) each with 30 g of fat from heavy cream, olive, sunflower, flaxseed or fish oil; samples before and 240 min after
population: n=23 healthy men and women, age 25.7 y, BMI 27.7
note: Five printed liquid meals with indirect calorimetry to 240 min, so energy expenditure sits beside the hormones. Areas only if no point values are printed.
